stage.name: Tipsy Merriment
stage.description:
The painting offers no wine; still, those who behold it indulge to excess.
<Grumbling Tummies> Before serving, Operators gradually lose increasing amounts of HP.
<Really Big Pot> Defeat edible enemies to add them to the pot and fill the Operators' bellies.

berry_slug.name: Berry Slug
berry_slug.flavourText: A creepy-crawly that lives in a mild environment, forming a symbiotic relationship with a particular species of plant. The berries it bears have a complex flavor, and are a rare delicacy.
abilities: Releases a blinding gleam upon taking damage, stunning surrounding allies for an extended period before attempting to escape via digging.
Drops <Shiny Berry> if defeated before escaping.

bitey.name: 'Bitey'
bitey.flavourText: A common Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. It's very smart and actually understands human speech. Apparently some kind of communal organism, it gets lonely when left by itself. It has done many a mean thing out of amusement for it's just an Ink Spirit, no matter how smart.

ink_brew.name: 'Ink Brew'
ink_brew.flavourText: A carefree Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. An inebriating aroma wafts from it, perhaps due to wine mixed into the ink—a joke from an old friend with a fondness for drink.
abilities: Non-Leader enemies passing by this enemy gain bonus ASPD and Movement Speed, and take less Physical and Arts damage.

fury.name: 'Fury'
fury.flavourText: A strong Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. Large and robust, but not very good at thinking. Tends to fall into the simplest traps and needs Bitey to save its ass. Gains attack power against opposite attribute enemies.
abilities: Greatly increases ATK when attacking opposite attribute targets
